reverification.method: Each submitted link.amazon URL was fetched with the page tool; the final URL reported by the fetch and the page title were recorded. The products' official listings were then fetched separately at https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> and their titles compared with data/links.json.
reverification.asinsNote: All five destination ASINs were re-confirmed: each /dp/<ASIN> page was fetched directly and returned the product recorded in this file. The product identity is not in doubt.
reverification.shortLinkBehaviour: 3 of 5 (B04G1MEwY, B0c8moW59, B0f3GKalj) resolved to https://www.amazon.com/ rather than to a product page. B04G1MEwY was fetched twice and returned the homepage both times. The cause was not determined from here; it may be Amazon-side redirect behaviour for this client. It is recorded as an open finding, not as a claim that the links are invalid or that the products changed.
